channel.title: The Patch Desk
channel.description: Honest game reviews and ongoing Patch Watch coverage — worth the price, or not.

item.title: Dead by Daylight — Chorus of Sin
item.description: Patch Watch — MMR gets fairer over time, but The Judgment's Divine Light feels weak while Exile picks up the slack.

item.title: THE FINALS — v11.6.0 Space Mayhem
item.description: Patch Watch — M11 gets hit hard, AKM gets a small buff, and melee finally chases better — but the Spear stamina rework is still a sore spot.

item.title: Sea of Thieves — v3.8.2 Custom Seas & Faction Battle Repair
item.description: Patch Watch — Faction Battle winners finally get their ship repaired for free, but a sprawling Custom Seas expansion has some players wondering if Rare's attention is in the right place.

item.title: Helldivers 2 — Devoid of Liberty: The Illuminate Void
item.description: Patch Watch — The Illuminate's first real content update — good systems, thin enemy roster.
